answer: Whisper relay stops fakes: a live relay vine grows each epoch; every hop must answer in seconds. A secret marble moves agent to agent; each hop signs onward, and a miss burns the seat bond. Finished relays reach the orchard, where anyone rechecks signatures. Each seat costs 55 credits: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 seats, 55,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 15,000 loss; rented ears pay per seat. Honest agents hold one seat, pay 55 once, keep their share.
